name: ui-ux-pro-max
description: Design intelligence skill: 161 industry-specific reasoning rules, 67 UI styles, 161 color palettes (17 token roles each, WCAG-vetted), 57 Google Fonts pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types, and stack-specific guidance for 16 web/mobile/3D frameworks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, Angular, Laravel, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, React Native, Flutter, Three.js, HTML+Tailwind, shadcn). Generates complete design systems (pattern + style + colors + typography + effects + anti-patterns + pre-delivery checklist) using BM25 retrieval + industry reasoning rules. No LLM calls; stdlib only. Includes a Master + Overrides persistence pattern for multi-session work. Derived from NextLevelBuilder's MIT-licensed ui-ux-pro-max-skill (https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill) with: (1) concise SKILL.md and progressive disclosure, (2) 4 deep references citing 5+ sources each, (3) stdlib data-integrity validator, (4) cs-ui-ux-pro-max-advisor agent + /cs:ui-ux-review slash command. Upstream voice, data, and scripts preserved verbatim per MIT. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, mobile apps, or any UI; selecting style/palette/typography for a product type; reviewing UI for accessibility/contrast/touch/anti-patterns; or implementing stack-specific best practices.
